entry.title: New: dsh-read-image-view
entry.summary: Displays the images read in the conversation (read_image results) in the DSH Web GUI: a dedicated Read image row with a default thumbnail and an in-page full-resolution lightbox (zoom buttons, mouse wheel, 1:1 original size), plus the metadata envelope. Exact install spec: github:yu-tao-li/dsh-read-image-view. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
